verdict.line: You lose if you stand in Ornn's Q (Volcanic Rupture) poke range before level 6; you win once W (Path Maker)'s charge-up and a 2-stack Q (Ntofo Strikes) let you force fights he can't Searing Charge away from, matching the 54.8% K'Sante win rate over 42 games.

brief.thesis: Ornn's long-range Q (Volcanic Rupture, 800 range) and Searing Charge threat control the first few levels, but K'Sante's W charge-up reduces damage taken through exactly that poke, and once Ntofo Strikes hits 2 stacks its shockwave pulls Ornn into a stun before his R (140s cooldown at rank 1) is ever up. That flip is why the head-to-head sits at 54.8% over 42 games even though the overall matchup shape is even.

theirWindow.what: Volcanic Rupture's slow sets up Searing Charge; if he collides with terrain mid-charge it knocks up, so back off the moment the fissure clips you instead of trading through it.

yourWindow.when: Q at 2 stacks or W charged
yourWindow.what: Engage the instant Ntofo Strikes reaches 2 stacks or Path Maker finishes its charge-up — the Q shockwave pulls him in and the W stun (pre-level-6) locks him for a full trade before Searing Charge is back up.

start.why: 54.5% win rate over 44 games and the 88% pick rate here outweigh the Doran's Shield line (6 games); the extra regen offsets Volcanic Rupture chip damage during the levels you can't contest range.

boots.why: 60% win rate over 25 games; the tenacity shortens how long Path Maker's stun-eating charge window gets interrupted and cuts the duration of his E shockwave knockup and R slow.

core.why: cooldown and on-hit magic damage speed up Ntofo Strikes stacking, getting you to the 2-stack pull faster in every trade
stacking resists directly counters a magic-damage opponent who is also stacking bonus Armor/MR from Living Forge
on-hit and anti-heal punish Ornn's Living Forge sustain items and his autos once he's forced into extended trades

situational.when: he rushes burst magic items off masterwork forging and you need the shield proc
his team stacks healing or you need the grievous wounds proc in skirmishes
you're the one leaning on sustain through extended trades instead of burst

runes.keystoneWhy: the matchup is a long poke-then-engage lane, not a burst lane — Grasp's permanent health and proc healing outlast Volcanic Rupture chip damage better than a burst keystone would.

summoners.why: Teleport is run in 84.3% of games (58.1% win rate) because this lane is about scaling into your 2-stack Q and Iceborn spike before resetting to help other lanes; take Ignite instead only if you're confident you can force a level 6 All Out kill before he can trade back.

playing.title: Wait for 2 Q stacks
playing.detail: Don't all-in on a single Ntofo Strikes hit — only commit once you're at 2 stacks, since the shockwave pulls Ornn in and removes his option to disengage before your W stun lands.

playing.title: Charge W into his Q
playing.detail: Path Maker's charge-up takes reduced damage, so start charging as he casts Volcanic Rupture to eat the fissure damage reduced, then release the dash into the stun while he's still on cooldown.

playing.title: Respect the magma pillar
playing.detail: Volcanic Rupture drops a pillar at its end location after a short delay — reposition off that spot immediately instead of standing there to finish a trade.

playing.title: Push when Searing Charge is down
playing.detail: After he whiffs or lands E without hitting terrain, his only knockup tool is on a 14-to-12 second cooldown; that's your clearest window to extend a trade.

playing.title: All Out before his R timer resets
playing.detail: Call of the Forge God starts at 140 seconds; look to knock him through terrain with R (All Out) and finish the kill in windows where his ultimate isn't up yet.

playing.title: Disengage on the Brittle gout
playing.detail: Bellows Breath's final flame applies Brittle and multiplies his next hits, not just autos — back off the instant it connects instead of trading through the debuff.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are from measured games on the current patch (OP.GG); the ability mechanics, timing windows, and trade patterns are my own tactical reading, not measured data.
